scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features --features wasm && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/eqts_example_add.wasm --out-dir dist/wasm --out-name index --target nodejs
scripts.test:napi: bun run build:napi && bun -e 'import { add } from "./dist/node-napi/index.js"; if (add(20, 22) !== 42) throw new Error("wrong result")'
scripts.test:wasm: bun run build:wasm && bun -e 'const { add } = require("./dist/wasm/index.js"); if (add(20, 22) !== 42) throw new Error("wrong result")'
